activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
Getting dressed and preparing for the workday
Setting up the home workspace, turning on the computer and desk lamp, checking email and reviewing the day's program schedule (working from home due to the transport strike)
Working on nonprofit community program coordination: drafting plans, replying to emails, joining video meetings
Preparing a simple lunch with the induction cooker and eating
Short break resting on the sofa, checking phone
Continuing work: program scheduling, partner communications, updating participant records
Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
Relaxing with the TV and playing a game on the game console
Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
Winding down, reading and checking phone under the desk lamp with the fan on
